briefings.headline: Be selective against Sánchez; make the fastball count
briefings.message: Cristopher Sánchez is the high-confidence expected starter. His changeup has a 46.5% whiff rate, so stay disciplined when it drops out of the zone. Wagaman, Bichette, Alvarez, and Semien have reported batter edges: hunt fastballs with Wagaman, Bichette, and Semien; Alvarez can look for breaking balls. Lefties should be ready for fastballs and avoid chasing the slider. Be prepared for Jhoan Duran, José Alvarado, and Orion Kerkering late.
reminders: Make Sánchez work; do not expand against his changeup or slider.
Look for your assigned pitch, then attack it.
Expect the Phillies’ rested late-inning arms if Sánchez goes deep.

briefings.headline: Peralta sets the tone; execute the matchups
briefings.message: Freddy Peralta starts as the only ready option, with a 90-pitch limit and a 5.0-inning target. Use the changeup as the main offspeed weapon, especially against Harper, whose expected xwOBA is 0.366; avoid predictable fastball patterns to Harper and Marsh. Vary locations against Schwarber, and stay in the zone against Turner to limit free bases and running chances. If Peralta exits early, use Peterson or Myers for length before middle relief. Raley and Weaver bridge close games to Williams; Manaea is limited and for necessity only.
reminders: Change speeds and locations against Schwarber.
Keep Turner off base; control running opportunities.
Save the late-game arms for leverage; use length after an early exit.

briefings.headline: Stay selective, protect the late innings
briefings.message: The lineup is built for the high-confidence Sánchez projection, with reported batter edges for Wagaman, Bichette, Alvarez, and Semien. Keep Soto, Bichette, Benge, and Semien in despite rest suggestions, as approved. Peralta starts with a 90-pitch limit and 5.0-inning target. If he exits early, use length before the high-leverage group; Raley and Weaver bridge to Williams in close games. Manaea is limited after 95 pitches over the last 3 days and is for necessity only. Jorge Polanco, Christian Scott, Luis Robert Jr., Tyrone Taylor, Clay Holmes, Ronny Mauricio, Francisco Lindor, Justin Hagenman, Dedniel Núñez, Tylor Megill, and Reed Garrett are out.
reminders: Apply the approved lineup and rest decisions.
Use Peterson or Myers for length after an early starter exit.
